Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2019

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi sembilan ratus tujuh puluh

enam juta enam ratus sembilan puluh empat ribu tiga ratus ringgit (RM 976,694,300)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2019.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2019

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding nine hundred seventy-six million six hundred

and ninety-four thousand three hundred ringgit (RM976,694,300) from the Social

Security Fund for the expenditure on administration of the Scheme of Social Security for

the year 2019 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE
